title: 第十六章 你们不是要找我吗第十七章 杀戮还是驾驭杀戮
lines: 谢进向冥雾中喊话：“李唯一，你师兄赵勐在我们手上，可惨了，膝盖骨都被打碎。”
“你们不是师兄弟情深吗？将佛祖舍利交出来，我们立即安排医师给他医治。”
“为了一颗佛祖舍利，你还真是自私。而且胆小怯弱，贪生怕死，哈哈，缩头乌龟一个……”
赵勐双腿和右臂被钢筋打断，因血脉不通而肿胀了起来。
谢天殊命人将他身上的衣服和裤子拔掉，顿时，错位的手臂骨头，和向前折断的小腿，显露在了众人眼前。
简直毛骨悚然，看着都疼痛入骨。
谢天殊见他如此模样，听他嘴里不断传出的沉闷惨吟，一时间都失去对他用刑的想法。在这样痛苦的状态下，什么样的酷刑都显得有些多余。
“老了，不服老不行啊！”
孔樊一边穿衣服，一边从医棚中走出来，嘴上说着“老了”，但脸上的笑容，却掩盖不住内心的春风得意，如重回少年时。
他才进去十分钟而已。
看到满身肥肉的孔樊，高欢目眦欲裂，吼声：“全是他妈的人渣，老子要杀了你！”
高欢没能冲过去，被后厨团队的一位成员，一脚踹倒在了地上。
“小子，你眼光不错，她真的很白很润。”
孔樊讥诮而得意的笑着，像是要把高欢气死才舒坦。
走过来后，看向被脱光扔在地上的赵勐，他道：“还没有问出来？小林，去厨棚找一罐辣椒油，炒滚烫后拿过来，给大副加点料。”
不多时，被称做“小林”的科考队员，端着一碗热腾腾的辣椒油跑了过来。
孔樊指点道：“将辣椒油倒到创伤处，若还不开口，就眼睛、耳朵、鼻子、嘴巴一起灌。”
那碗里辣椒油的油温，怕是得有两三百度。
只是听孔樊的描述，就吓得众多科考队员慑慑发抖，不敢想象他们能够做出如此残忍的事。
唯有赵勐显得很平静，只恨现在连自杀速死的力量都没有。太窝囊，丢尽师门的脸。
刺耳的破风声响起。
一道长长的黄芒，从冥雾中飞出，击中小林的右肩胛骨。
是一柄剑，黄龙剑。
黄龙剑的整个剑体都穿透过去，只余剑柄露在外面。强大的冲击力，将小林带飞出去，斜抛到两米外的地上。
随小林的惨叫声响起，碗中滚烫的辣椒油脱手，泼洒在了孔樊脚上。
孔樊叫声惨烈，跳脚不止，脚背上一个个血泡冒了起来。
“哗啦啦！”
金石摩擦声与奔步声响起，转瞬由冥雾深处而至众人眼前。
李唯一拖枪而行，枪尖与地面摩擦出一条火花光路。
速度太快了，不输鬼熊皇多少。
就在谢天殊拔枪欲射之际，丈长的黑色长枪，呈泰山压顶之势已抵达他头顶。枪杆挥击的风声，能刺痛耳膜。
“噗嗤！”
谢天殊险之又险的避过头颅。
但右肩却被枪锋劈中，就像切豆腐一般，整条手臂飞了出去。

;;
Xie Jin shouted into the mist: "Li Weiwei, your senior brother Zhao Meng is in our hands. It's terrible. His kneecaps are all broken."
"Don't you have a deep love for each other as brothers? Hand over the Buddha's relics and we will immediately arrange for doctors to treat him."
"For a Buddha relic, you are really selfish. You are also timid, greedy for life and afraid of death, haha, you are so shy..."
…
Zhao Meng's legs and right arm were broken by steel bars and swollen due to blocked blood vessels.
Xie Tianshu ordered people to take off his clothes and trousers, and immediately, the dislocated arm bones and the broken calf were revealed to everyone.
It was so creepy that it hurt my bones just to look at it.
Xie Tianshu saw him like this and listened to the dull moans that kept coming from his mouth, and for a moment he lost the idea of ​​torture him. In such a painful state, any kind of torture seems redundant.
"I'm old, I can't accept it!"
Kong Fan walked out of the medical shed while getting dressed, saying "I'm old", but the smile on his face couldn't hide the joy in his heart, as if he was a boy again.
He had only been in for ten minutes.
Seeing the fat Kong Fan, Gao Huan's eyes were splitting and he shouted: "You are all fucking scum, I'm going to kill you!"
Gao Huan failed to rush over and was kicked to the ground by a member of the kitchen team.
"Boy, you have good taste. She is really fair and moist."
Kong Fan smiled sarcastically and proudly, as if he wanted to make Gao Huan angry to death before he felt comfortable.
After walking over, he looked at Zhao Meng who was stripped naked and thrown on the ground. He said, "You haven't asked yet? Xiao Lin, go to the kitchen shed to find a can of chili oil. Stir fry it until it's hot. Bring it over and add some ingredients to the first mate."
Not long after, the scientific expedition team member known as "Xiao Lin" ran over with a bowl of hot chili oil.
Kong Fan pointed out: "Pour the chili oil into the injured area. If you still don't open your mouth, pour it into your eyes, ears, nose, and mouth."
The temperature of the chili oil in that bowl must be two to three hundred degrees.
Just listening to Kong Fan's description made many scientific expedition members tremble with fear, unable to imagine that they could do such cruel things.
Only Zhao Meng seemed very calm, regretting that he didn't even have the strength to commit suicide and die quickly. He's so cowardly, he'll disgrace his entire school.
"Wow!"
The harsh sound of breaking wind sounded.
A long yellow light flew out of the dark mist and hit Xiao Lin's right shoulder blade.
It's a sword, the Yellow Dragon Sword.
The entire body of the Huanglong Sword penetrated, leaving only the hilt exposed. The powerful impact took Xiao Lin flying and threw him diagonally to the ground two meters away.
As Xiao Lin screamed, the hot chili oil in the bowl spilled on Kong Fan's feet.
"Ah..."
Kong Fan screamed ferociously, his feet kept jumping, and blood blisters appeared on the insteps.
"Crash!"
The sound of friction between gold and stone and the sound of running could be heard in an instant, coming from the depths of the mist before everyone's eyes.
Li Weiwei dragged the gun, and the tip of the gun rubbed against the ground to create a path of sparks.
The speed is too fast, not much inferior to the Ghost Bear Emperor.
Just when Xie Tianshu drew his gun and was about to shoot, the ten-foot-long black spear reached above his head like a mountain. The sound of the gun swinging in the wind can sting the eardrums.
"Pfft!"
Xie Tianshu narrowly avoided his head.
But his right shoulder was hit by the spear point, like cutting tofu, and his whole arm flew out.
title_en: Chapter 16 Aren’t you looking for me? Chapter 17 Killing or controlling killing?
